convergence.title: Plate with a hole, P1 vs. P2

rates.noRate: There is no rate to fit here. The quadratic series does not converge monotonically: the peak of element-centre stresses averaged to the nodes moves between nodes from one mesh to the next. The linear one falls steadily but has not yet reached the range where its slope settles. Recovering the stress at the integration points would give both a rate.
